# improve update process

Stop Oh My Zsh from interrupting shell start-up with its own update prompt:

```
$ [oh-my-zsh] Would you like to update? [Y/n]
Updating Oh My Zsh
```

(the attached screenshot showed the prompt appearing in a fresh terminal). The dotfiles already update Oh My Zsh as part of `self-update` ([#2](DOT-2.md)); the framework's periodic check duplicates that and blocks the prompt at the worst moment. The research question was how to disable the built-in check without losing updates.
